notes.title: Patch Notes 1.31
notes.notes: Fixed Some Issues with VR Menus

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.notes:
Note: In order to move to 5.5, we had to reset save games. This only effects stats and character/weapon unlocks, not leaderboards.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.255
notes.notes:
Fixed location of damage blood splatter
 Nerfed C4 damage radius to make it less harmful for the player
 Removed spinning knives damage on trip mines

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.25
notes.notes:
C4 allows player to replace the roll button with drop-able C4s mines that you can explode by shooting. C4 can also be "tripped" by zombies touching it
 Adjusted HUD to be more understandable
 Fixed death animation on Steam Deck

notes.title: 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New Tracker Anchored VR Menus
 Fixed VR main menu incorrectly on push down LS
 Delayed difficulty ramp up 
 Fixed audio concurrency issues
 Boss and tall zombies drop more coins
 Fixed damage multiplier
 Increased nuke and exploding barrel
 Balanced boss and tall zombie end game spawns
 Capped penetration count
 General weapon and power-up balancing
 Fixed rare invisible enemy bug
 Made shop text more readable

notes.title: Patch 1.1 Notes
notes.notes:
Significant End Game Difficulty boost - Prepare for the Brute Invasion
 Turret Buff!  Much more fun - spawn multiple turrets, modified damage and cooldowns
 Nerfed Laser duration, fixed bug
 General Weapon Balancing
 New Global and User leaderboard panels!
 VR - Fix issue with menu interaction collisions
 Support powerups changes to on RT on Gamepad
 Gamepad D-Pad control change
 Increased difficulty ramp up in late game
 Note - After this patch we will need to wipe leaderboards

notes.title: 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.notes: - Added Stereo Compositor Layers to make text and menus more legible!

notes.title: 1.0155 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed weapon upgrade bug found in last patch
 Removed fat zombie wave for a smoother late game experience
 Switched to linear progression system to buff XP leveling
 Fixed coins bug on store in (VR only)
 Fixed clumping humans bug

notes.title: 1.015 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Reworked most weapon upgrades increasing buffs and removing negative modifiers to allow smoother leveling
- Fixed rollover bug not showing correct time greater than one hour

notes.title: 1.01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you to all of our players and their feedback since our launch last night. 
Below are a few initial balancing patches.


 Adjusted most powerup costs to better match each powerup's strength
 Moderately nerfed Laser, Flamethrower, Sentry Turret, Rocket, Shield, and Speed powerups to scale across gameplay
 Moderately buffed most weapon upgrades to better match each powerup's strengths
 Capped each powerup's max level to 10
 Fixed Humans attracting to Deadmeat
 Fixed unintentional reroll count
